data.name: Keri
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Keri was a Nereid, a sea goddess. The name is derived from the Greek word 'kera', meaning 'horn' or 'head', symbolizing strength and power. In Christianity, Keri is associated with St. Jerome, the patron saint of librarians and scholars, whose name is derived from 'keros', meaning 'wax', symbolizing the preservation and transmission of knowledge.

By embracing the name, an individual may reflect on the spiritual value of knowledge and its role in deepening their faith.
